name: session-lifecycle
body: Session lifecycle and exclusivity: `apg session start` launches the coordinator and binds the worktree socket; `apg session end` flushes the derived projection and exits; a stale socket left by a crash is reclaimed by the next command/session; one session per worktree DB; a live session and `apg scan` / `apg project merge` are mutually exclusive. (Not yet built — planned code.)
